It provides definitions of key terms, specifies access protocols, and details the rules and regulations suppliers must follow, including security arrangements and conduct guidelines. The document also covers provisions for accommodation, messing facilities, medical treatments, transport, and financial arrangements for supplier representatives. Furthermore, it incorporates Defence Conditions (DEFCONs) and Defence Forms (DEFFORMS) into the contract, and clarifies procedures for authorisation of third-party intellectual property rights. Summary: 
The document titled "RM6116 Framework Schedule 5 Management Charges and Information Vfinal" outlines the comprehensive MI reporting requirements that suppliers must adhere to under the Network Services 3 framework (Framework Number RM6116). Suppliers are required to provide timely and accurate MI Reports using templates provided and reviewed periodically by CCS. Reports must be submitted electronically and in pounds sterling, unless otherwise approved. The information provided is used by CCS for operational activities, public sector expenditure monitoring, and future procurement planning. Suppliers must pay management charges within 30 days of invoicing and may face penalties, including suspended agreements, interest charges, or contract termination, for late payments or incorrect reporting. Regular audits assess compliance, with corrective actions mandated for any identified errors.

Summary: The Contract Award Service (CAS) is a procurement tool designed to streamline the buying process for government departments and public sector buyers. CAS provides an online platform for filtering suppliers, issuing RFIs and EOIs, conducting further competition or direct awards, awarding contracts, providing feedback, and generating audit trails. It supports purchases from four specific agreements: G-Cloud 13, G-Cloud 13 Lot 4, Digital Outcomes 6 (DOS 6), and Management Consultancy Framework Three (MCF3). Users need to follow a specific process including creating a Public Procurement Gateway (PPG) account. Detailed guidance and support are available to assist users in navigating the system.

Framework Name: Spark DPS  
Framework Number: RM6094  
Category: Digital and Technology Services  

Objective:  
Spark DPS, also known as the Technology Innovation Marketplace, supports government and public sector entities in accessing new and emerging technology products and services. The system is designed to facilitate the procurement of innovations in areas such as IoT, AI, simulated environments, wearables, and security improvements. It utilizes a sophisticated filter system to match customers with suppliers offering relevant and impactful technological solutions.

Scope:  
- Eligible Sectors: Government, Public Sector  
- Service Types:  
  - Internet of Things (IoT)  
  - Artificial Intelligence (AI) and automation  
  - Simulated and enhanced environments  
  - Engineering/materials science  
  - Data solutions  
  - Wearables  
  - Transport  
  - Security  

Restrictions:  
Suppliers applying to join the marketplace must demonstrate their ability to provide innovative products, either through Radical Innovation or Disruptive Innovation, and must have their contract examples approved by customers. Suppliers can apply at any time, and the assessment process reportedly takes up to 15 working days.  
For additional details and bid pack information, visit the [Spark DPS Agreement Page](https://www.crowncommercial.gov.uk/agreements/RM6094).

Framework Name: Leasing and Loan Finance DPS  
Framework Number: RM6120  
Category: Financial Services  

Objective:  
This DPS facilitates access to funding for government and public sector bodies seeking to acquire assets. It provides a variety of financing options, including leasing and asset-secured loans. It connects customers to a range of lenders for efficient asset acquisition financing.

Scope:
- Eligible Sectors:
  - Central government
  - Ministry of Defence
  - Local authorities
  - Health
  - Education
  - Other public sectors

- Service Types:
  - Hire purchase (asset ownership after installment payment completion)
  - Finance lease (lender retains legal ownership during lease)
  - Operating lease (temporary asset use without ownership transfer)
  - Sale and leaseback (asset is sold and leased back from the buyer)
  - Asset-secured loans (asset used as collateral)

Restrictions:  
Fleet financing requiring Contract Hire must use the Vehicle Lease, Fleet Management & Flexible Rental Solutions agreement (RM6096). Property financing is not eligible. Asset value must be a minimum of £2000, with no maximum limit applied.

For further details, refer to the agreement specification through the provided URL: [Leasing and Loan Finance DPS RM6120](https://www.crowncommercial.gov.uk/agreements/RM6120).

Framework Name: Print Management Services  
Framework Number: RM6170  
Category: Hardware  

Objective:  
To provide fully managed end-to-end print products and services, including bulk printing, direct mail, and secure print services, to all public sector organizations across the UK.

Scope:
- Eligible Sectors: All public sector organizations
- Service Types:
  - Command and house paper services (Lot 1 only)
  - Bulk printing
  - Full range of print products (envelopes, labels, folders)
  - Operational print (brochures, leaflets, business cards, business stationary)
  - Finishing services (binding, stamping, embossing, laminating)
  - Direct mail and transactional print services
  - Alternative formats (easy read, large print, alternative languages, audio, braille)
  - Secure print services and items
  - Print stock management and distribution
  - Pre-production services (content creation, digital asset management, typesetting, proofreading, translation)
  - Digital solutions and transformation services (email, SMS, website)
  - Election print and election mailing services
  - Associated print services (scanning, microfiche, secure shredding, media duplication, part of overall print management service)

Restrictions:
- Services under RM6071 Print Marketplace framework recommended for customers not needing print management support.
- Command and house paper services only available through Lot 1.
- Services not designed to be used separately but as part of an overall print management service.  
- Agreement duration: 4 years.  
- Customer call-off contracts: Up to 4 years, may include extensions (e.g., 2+1+1 years).

  - Support for transferring records under the Public Records Act 30/20 year rule

**Framework Number**: RM6184  
**Category**: Construction  

**Objective**:  
Provide an efficient and cost-effective solution for offsite construction needs, offering both 3D volumetric modular and 2D panelised building methods. Enable public sector organizations to access full 'turn key' packages, from design to maintenance of prefabricated buildings. Ensure reduced disruption and lead time through offsite manufacturing and local or national delivery.

**Scope**:  
- **Eligible Sectors**: Public sector organizations  
- **Service Types**:  
  - Design, fabrication, and physical delivery of offsite construction solutions  
  - Construction or installation of prefabricated buildings  
  - Maintenance of prefabricated buildings  
  - Both permanent and temporary buildings

**Restrictions**:  
- There is no maximum contract length.  
- Agreement runs for 4 years until 23 January 2027, with an option to extend by 3 years until 23 January 2030.

**Framework Name**: Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Solutions (VCIS)  
**Framework Number**: RM6213  
**Category**: Digital and Technology Services  

**Objective**:  
The Vehicle Charging Infrastructure Solutions (VCIS) framework provides central government and public sector entities with access to a range of products and services to support the development of electric and hybrid vehicle charging infrastructure. It allows buyers to procure either full end-to-end solutions or specific elements as needed to facilitate the transition to low emission vehicles.

**Scope**:
- Eligible Sectors: Central government, wider public sector
- Service Types:
  - Consultancy and feasibility studies
  - Civil design and installation
  - Provision, installation, and maintenance of charging hardware
  - Software and back-office solutions
  - Lease and purchase options for products
  - Comprehensive end-to-end service solutions

**Restrictions**:  
- No maximum contract length
- Unlimited supplier spaces, contingent on meeting selection criteria
- No cost for suppliers to join the agreement

**Additional Information**:  
CCS supports the deployment of EV infrastructure via two agreements: Transport Technology and Associated Services (TTAS) and VCIS. A Dynamic Purchasing System (DPS) is used for filtering relevant suppliers. Explore key differences and procurement scenarios on the provided [VCIS agreement page](https://www.crowncommercial.gov.uk/agreements/RM6213).

**Framework Name:** Payment Solutions 2  
**Framework Number:** RM6248  
**Category:** Financial Services  

**Objective:**  
The Payment Solutions 2 agreement enables UK government and wider public sector customers to purchase goods and services using procurement cards and disburse funds via prepaid cards and voucher solutions. It provides an online management system for real-time purchase and fund disbursement management. Bespoke and off-the-shelf solutions are available to suit different needs.

**Scope:**  
- **Eligible Sectors:** UK government, wider public sector
- **Service Types:**
  - Procurement card solutions for purchasing goods and services, including travel
  - Prepaid card and voucher solutions for fund disbursement
  - Online management information system
  - Both off-the-shelf and bespoke solutions (bespoke solutions require further competition)

**Restrictions:**  
Providers must either have Cyber Essentials Plus accreditation or be progressing towards it with acceptable interim accreditations. Compliance will be monitored continuously, and suppliers must meet specific requirements before entering into a Call-off agreement. The agreement is valid for 3 years with an option for a 1-year extension.

Framework Number: RM6265  
Category: Fleet  

Objective:  
Vehicle Hire Solutions RM6265 provides UK public sector organizations with access to a wide range of vehicle hire services. These services support operational fleet needs, business travel, and specialist vehicle requirements both in the UK and overseas. This framework ensures flexible rental durations and access to various vehicle types to meet diverse public sector needs.

Scope:  
- Eligible Sectors: All UK public sector organizations  
- Service Types:  
  - Business travel vehicle hire (e.g., cars for meetings)  
  - Operational fleets (e.g., vans, HGV tippers)  
  - Seasonal needs (e.g., road gritters)  
  - Car share models with hourly rates  
  - Standard short term rentals  
  - Flexible rentals for use over 28 days  
  - Specialist vehicles (e.g., emergency vehicles, healthcare operational vehicles, bespoke vehicles)

Restrictions:  
This agreement will last for 4 years.

None specified.

Framework Name: Restructuring & Insolvency Services  
Framework Number: RM6269  
Category: Professional Services  
Objective: UK government and public sector bodies can access specialist restructuring and insolvency services from a range of suppliers in a cost-effective way. Central government departments can utilize these services during instances of corporate distress where there is a governmental interest.  

Scope:
- Eligible sectors: Government and public sector bodies  
- Service types: 
  - Accelerated mergers and acquisitions
  - Business review
  - Cash-flow review
  - Distressed debt restructuring
  - General restructuring advice
  - Insolvency contingency planning
  - Options analysis

Restrictions (if any): The agreement will last for 3 years, with an option to extend for an additional 12 months. While there is no defined maximum length for a call-off agreement under this framework, it is recommended that call-offs should not exceed 4 years.

Framework Name: Non Clinical Staffing  
Framework Number: RM6277  
Category: HR and Workforce Services

Objective: This framework enables public and third sector organizations to hire quality non-clinical workers through various engagement models, including fixed-term positions, temporary roles, and contractors. It aims to provide efficient staffing solutions for roles across diverse administrative and support services.

Scope: 
- Eligible Sectors:
  - NHS contracting authorities
  - Central government
  - Local government
  - Universities
  - Charities
  - Emergency (blue light) services

- Service Types:
  - Administration and secretarial roles
  - Finance, accounts, and audit roles
  - IT technicians, analysts, and digital workers
  - Legal secretaries, paralegals, and lawyers
  - Environmental and scientific roles (e.g., senior assistant scientists, clinical coders)
  - Catering, driving, and security roles
  - Estates and maintenance roles (e.g., electricians, surveyors)
  - Project management and managed services

Restrictions: Roles requiring medical qualifications are out of scope and can be sourced through the Clinical Staffing agreement.

For more information, visit: [Non Clinical Staffing RM6277](https://www.crowncommercial.gov.uk/agreements/RM6277)

Framework Name: Managed Staff Banks  
Framework Number: RM6278  
Category: HR and Workforce Services  

Objective: This framework provides options for managed outsourced staff bank services aimed primarily at the NHS but open to all public sector bodies, including central government. It offers two service models to manage any or all elements of staff bank operations. The aim is to help businesses address staffing gaps, manage workforce effectively, and improve shift fill rates.  

Scope:  
- Eligible Sectors: NHS, public sector bodies, central government  
- Service Types:  
  - Internal and external recruitment of bank workers  
  - Ensuring compliance with NHS employment check standards  
  - Payroll management  
  - Performance management services  
  - Management of agency cascade for unfilled positions  

Restrictions:  
Contracts can be let for any period, typically 3 to 4 years, depending on workforce strategy. Call-off contracts will continue to run their full course even after the agreement ends.  

[Link to agreement](https://www.crowncommercial.gov.uk/agreements/RM6278)

Framework Name: Print and Digital Communications  
Framework Number: RM6297  
Category: Hardware  

Objective:
The Print and Digital Communications agreement provides comprehensive managed print products and services, including bulk printing, direct mail, and secure print. It is designed for public sector organizations requiring the expertise of a print manager. Customers can access services through two distinct lots based on their purchasing needs.

Scope:
- Eligible Sectors: All public sector organizations across the UK
- Service Types:
  - Lot 1: Single supplier (direct award for command and house paper services)
  - Lot 2: Multiple suppliers (further competition)
  - Services available:
    - Command and house paper services (Lot 1 only)
    - Bulk printing and full range of print products (envelopes, labels, folders)
    - Operational print (brochures, leaflets, business cards, business stationery)
    - Finishing services (binding, stamping, embossing, laminating)
    - Alternative formats (easy read, large print, alternative languages, audio, braille)
    - Secure print services and items
    - Print stock management and distribution
    - Digital solutions and transformation services (email, SMS, website)
    - Election print and mailing services
  - Associated services: 
    - Scanning and microfiche services
    - Secure shredding of confidential waste 
    - Media duplication services

Restrictions:
Associated print services are only available as part of the overall print management service and not separately. Command and house paper services require engagement with HH Global early in the process. The framework runs for 4 years, with customer call-off contracts up to 4 years starting any time before the agreement ends. Call-off contracts can be full-term or initial period with options to extend.

**Framework Name:** Water, Wastewater and Ancillary Services 3  
**Framework Number:** RM6306  
**Category:** Energy  

**Objective:**  
This framework agreement provides retail services for water supply and wastewater (sewerage), along with essential ancillary services. It helps organizations manage water billing, improve customer service, and explore optional services that reduce water usage, save money, and lower carbon emissions.

**Scope:**  
- **Eligible Sectors:** Public sector organizations with non-residential premises in England, Wales, and Northern Ireland, including schools, NHS trusts, and local authorities.  
- **Service Types:**
  - Managed water billing
  - Customer service
  - Optional services for water conservation, cost savings, and carbon reduction

**Restrictions:**
- Organizations served by a water supplier in Wales can only switch water retailers if they use more than 50 million litres (ML) of water a year.
  - If you use more than 50 ML a year: you can choose to switch retailer or stay with your current supplier.
  - If you use 50 ML or less a year: you will continue to get services from your regional water company and cannot switch using this framework.

  - Products/services for covert operations, blue light fleet, and incident management

  - Security (alarm response, access control, passes, perimeter guarding)  
  - Visitor support services (reception duties, telephony services)  
  - Grounds maintenance (soft landscaping, tree surgery, snow and ice clearance, planting)

Objective:  
Technology Products & Associated Services 2 aims to provide UK public sector organizations with easy access to a wide range of technology hardware, software, and associated services.   - Technology infrastructure: servers, storage, backup, data centers, network hardware, hubs, routers, switches

  - Consumables: cabling, connectors, data storage devices, memory sticks
  - Peripheral equipment: keyboards, mice, screens, monitors, audio-visual equipment
  - Commercial off the shelf (COTS) software: Microsoft, VMware, Google, Oracle, ServiceNow, antivirus software, Adobe

Restrictions:  
This agreement runs for 48 months. The length of call-off contracts is flexible, allowing organizations to determine the contract duration.
